answer: A pulse of activity every epoch refreshes the bond; letting it lapse zeroes reputation. Sybil resistance via staked reputation slot: each agent must lock a saffron-tagged bond before voting, and peers verify a signed quill mark tied to that stake. Attackers must fund each fake identity, so mass forgery scales linearly in real cost while honest participants recover stake after good behavior. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
